Subject: Thornbury Lounge Group - Unable to Quote

Hi Celia,

Thank you for thinking of us for Thornbury Lounge Group. I've reviewed the submission, and unfortunately we'll need to decline this opportunity.

Our appetite doesn't include nightclubs or bars with entertainment (Class NITE), so we're not able to provide a competitive quote for this risk.

I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty market that focuses on hospitality and entertainment venues—they'll be better positioned to offer appropriate coverage and pricing for this type of operation.

I appreciate you considering us, and please don't hesitate to reach out with other submissions that might be a better fit!

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
